topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: ESG funds may weight environmental, social and governance factors differently.
question: Misconception: Every ESG fund gives equal weight to environmental, social, and governance factors, so each one will support the same priorities.
answer: ESG funds can weigh these factors differently, and the factors are subjective. Check how a fund’s index is constructed and what it holds rather than assuming it supports all three areas equally or matches your priorities.
